title: infrastructure-capacity-intake-canvas-apr-2026
content:
Purpose / context:
This is a lightweight, living intake tracker (spreadsheet style) for all GPU/accelerator capacity requests across regions. Goal: reduce duplicate asks, make prioritization visible, and speed approvals for time-sensitive experiments and customer demos. Use this canvas for initial intake; final allocation actions happen in the allocation board (see linked Confluence).

How to use (short):
- Submit a new row for any request >= 1 GPU-week or any request that requires a new SKU/region.
- Add Jira ticket reference and notify #infra-gpu-intake.
- Triage owner (eng-infra capacity triage) will ack within 3 business days and assign priority.
- Approved rows move to the allocation queue with an assigned allocation owner and ETA.

Tracker columns (single-line examples below):
Request ID | Date | Team | Project / Feature | Req GPU type | Count (units) | Region(s) | Window start | Window end | Priority (P0/P1/P2) | Business Owner | Eng Lead | Justification / Notes | Dependencies | Estimated GPU-weeks | Approval status | Approved by | Allocation owner | Follow-ups
CR-2026-042 | 2026-04-08 | product-hosted-api | latency-benchmarking-v2 | A100-80GB | 8 | us-west1 | 2026-05-02 | 2026-05-16 | P1 | Tara Nguyen | Jonah Becker | required to validate batching changes and kernel selection; needs KV-cache warmup tests | model-v2 roll -> INFRA-4312 | 16 | pending | (empty) | (empty) | need final biz sign-off
CR-2026-053 | 2026-04-20 | solutions-engineering | enterprise-demo-telecom | L40S | 4 | eu-west1 | 2026-05-10 | 2026-05-12 | P0 | Marco Silva | Mina Patel | customer-facing demo for large telco; SLA must be guaranteed during demo window | customer onboarding sequence + encryption key access | 2 | approved | Priya Shah | infrastructure-oncall | make sure VPC peering is ready, KMS keys available
CR-2026-056 | 2026-04-27 | research-applied-ml | quant-research-8bit | H100 | 16 | us-east4,apac-sg | 2026-06-01 | 2026-06-14 | P2 | Dr. Emily Chen | Liam O'Connor | multi-region stress tests for quantization profiles; can be delayed if capacity constrained | none | 48 | pending | (empty) | (empty) | consider bursting into preemptible pool

Triage rubric (quick):
- P0: Customer-facing demo, SLA-backed enterprise launch, or critical incident mitigation (must include business owner + exec sponsor).
- P1: High-value product experiments with short runway (<=6 weeks) or capacity that materially changes unit economics; needs eng lead and test plan.
- P2: Exploratory research, long-horizon experiments, or background bake-offs — low blocking risk.

Approval process (short):
1) Intake row -> triage owner ack in 3 business days (comment with initial priority).
2) If P0/P1: route to infra-capacity-squad lead + finance (cost estimate) for approval within 5 business days.
3) Once approved -> allocation owner assigned; add to allocation board and set ETA + pre-provision ticket.
4) For multi-region requests, include network and compliance owners for final signoff (private deployments require security review).

Cost & billing notes (quick):
- Rough cost estimate: A100-80GB = $X / GPU-week (internal ratecard link in Confluence).
- Req > 200 GPU-weeks requires procurement notice and headcount license checks.
- For demo & P0 allocations, finance will flag a temporary budget hold and accelerate procurement.

Operational caveats / reminders:
- Avoid requesting mixed SKU pools unless experiment strictly requires it; it complicates scheduling and billing.
- For long windows (>30 days), split into multiple allocations (reduces opportunity cost).
- If request depends on private deployment stacks, attach the private-deployments runbook ID.
- Preemptible/spot pools are preferred for P2 unless latency guarantees are required.

Open questions & TODOs (notes-to-self style):
- Add a small column for "preferred kernel optimization" (e.g., flash-attn, fused softmax) — helps serving/runtime team pick kernels.
- Consider field for "expected token throughput" for production scale requests — value: helps choose batch sizes.
- Automate Slack ack via webhook when a new row is added. See INFRA-4199.

Weekly cadence / owners:
- Triage sync: Mon 10:00am PT (30m) — capacity triage owners: Jonah / Aisha / Mina.
- Allocation planning: Wed 2:00pm PT — allocation owners review approved rows and schedule.
- Emergency re-org: ad-hoc via #infra-gpu-intake for P0 escalations.

Example notes from triage (history):
- 2026-04-09 (Jonah): flagged CR-2026-042 as P1; asked product to attach the benchmark harness and seed data.
notes_summary: living intake tracker for GPU/accelerator requests, triage rubric, process steps, example rows, owners, cadence
